# MERIDIAN (07 · meridian)

A Swiss editorial quarterly on a strict 12-column grid, set in IKB blue with a collapsing masthead.

- **Technique:** EDITORIAL GRID
- **Tags:** editorial, swiss, magazine, grid, journalism, light, typographic
- **Best for:** magazines; blogs; reports; think tanks
- **Fonts:** Inter Tight, Inter
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,800;0,900;1,300;1,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #fafaf7 · #101010 · #0031c6
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/meridian/` (Template.astro, content.ts, figure.ts, meta.ts, progress.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* meridian — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --paper: #fafaf7;
  --ink: #101010;
  --ink2: #3c3c3a;
  --ink3: #8a8a85;
  --blue: #0031c6;
  --rule: #d8d8d2;
  --card: #fff;
  /* cover figure (departure-board illustration) */
  --blue-deep: #001a68;
  --blue-light: #3b63ff;
  --board: #050b18;
  --board-ink: #f2f6ff;
  --board-off: #20304f;
  --alert: #c73e1d;
  --cable: #0a1430;
  --floor: #001048;
  --tight: "Inter Tight", sans-serif;
  --body: "Inter", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `figure.ts`
  - `initFigure(host: HTMLElement)` — Duotone generative cover figure: an abstracted departure board, hanging lamp, waiting figure and bench, drawn as inline SVG with a film-grain filter. Colors come from the theme tokens.
- `progress.ts`
  - `initMasthead(bar: HTMLElement, masthead: Element)` — Fill `bar` to the page scroll fraction and collapse `masthead` once scrolled past 90px.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  masthead: {
    /** Blue label at the top-left of the masthead strip. */
    issue: string;
    /** Centre label of the masthead strip. */
    season: string;
    /** Publication name set huge; collapses to a slim bar on scroll. */
    name: string;
    /** Blue punctuation mark after the name. */
    mark: string;
    /** Right-aligned tagline beside the name (hidden below 760px). `<br>` allowed. */
    taglineHtml: string;
  };
  lead: {
    /** Small blue category label. */
    category: string;
    /** Cover-story headline; `<em>` renders light italic. */
    headingHtml: string;
    standfirst: string;
    /** `<b>` renders darker. */
    bylineHtml: string;
    cta: { label: string; href: string };
    figure: {
      /** Bold label before the caption, e.g. "Fig. 01". */
      label: string;
      caption: string;
      /** Right-aligned note in the caption row. */
      note: string;
    };
  };
  features: {
    title: string;
    /** Right-aligned note on the section rule. */
    note: string;
    stories: {
      /** Blue story number. */
      no: string;
      title: string;
      summary: string;
      /** Section and reading time, e.g. "Systems · 18 min". */
      meta: string;
      href: string;
    }[];
  };
  quote: {
    /** Pull quote; `<b>` renders heavy upright. */
    textHtml: string;
    cite: string;
  };
  index: {
    /** Anchor id targeted by the lead CTA. */
    id: string;
    /** Sticky heading beside the list; `<br>` and a `<span>` accent mark allowed. */
    headingHtml: string;
    rows: {
      label: string;
      /** Big blue figure on the right. */
      value: string;
    }[];
  };
  /**
   * Colophon columns. When the page is rendered with `showcase`, the showcase credit line is
   * appended to the last block.
   */
  colophon: {
    label: string;
    /** `<br>` and `<a>` allowed. */
    bodyHtml: string;
  }[];
}
```
